messages:
sam: FYI — after the kernel reorder landed last night we're seeing ~12-18% p99 regression on Mixtral MoE with top-k=4. Noticed higher KV eviction rates too. pinging @jia @mike for triage.
jia: Oof. Can you paste the perf run and the serve flags you used?
sam: ran the standard bench on canary rack 7, here's the gist:
```bash
perf record -F 99 -a -g -- python3 tools/serve_bench.py --model mixtral-8x32 --route topk=4 --seq 2048 --concurrency 16
# aggregated numbers from the run: p50 18ms p95 86ms p99 190ms (previous baseline p99 165ms)
# nvprof snapshot: local kernel time breakdown -> softmax: 47%, rope_rescale: 18%, router_logits: 9%
```
mike: interesting that softmax jumped. any change in score scaling or temp? config snippet?
sam: serving config was default for canary: `router: { top_k: 4, score_scale: 1.0, softmax_temp: 1.0 }` and we did the kernel reorder (softmax_v2 became preferred). KV cache metrics I pulled right after run:
```
KV cache hit_rate: 72% -> 59%
KV evictions/sec: 1200 -> 4300
GPU SM stall (mem): 23% -> 41%
```
tess: that eviction spike explains the mem stall. If the new softmax changes per-token latency the router may be keeping tokens hot longer which thrashes expert caches. Try lowering top_k to 2 for an AB to see hit-rate impact.
jia: I think RoPE rescale could be interacting here. The reordered kernels surfaced a vectorized ropescale we enabled; maybe it pushes more tail work into softmax path. Quick experiment: try forcing old softmax kernel + old rope for the canary: `--kernel-priority=softmax_v1,rope_scalar` and run one perf pass. If p99 drops back and KV hit recovers then we nailed it.
mike: alternative mitigation: keep top_k=4 but reduce `router.score_scale` to 0.85 and set `expert_parallelism=2` (less per-expert memory working set). That should lower evictions without changing model semantics much. We can canary both variants.
infra-bot: deploy 3251234601 -> canary/mixtral-reorder-rollout started by infra-deploy-bot :rocket:
sam: started the `--kernel-priority` run against canary-7 now, will post numbers in ~10m.
ja: if the kernel priority fix helps, we should add a targeted microbenchmark in perf-suite for softmax+rope combo to catch regressions in CI. Also add a KV hit tracker in the canary dashboard.
mike: agree. I'll draft the canary matrix: A) top_k=4 + kernel-priority softmax_v1,rope_scalar B) top_k=2 + softmax_v2 C) top_k=4 + score_scale=0.85 + expert_parallelism=2. Keep same traffic slice and compare p99 and KV hit.
tess: sounds good. who wants to own running the matrix?
jia: I'll run the experiments and collect traces, ping me if you want access to the canary nodes.
sam: thanks — appreciate the quick triage. will follow up with the perf artifacts and flamegraphs. :thumbsup:
mike: looks like a plan. if we see kernel-vs-routing interaction we should add a note to the kernel selection heuristics (prefer older softmax when MoE and high-k routing are detected).
sam: noted. tagging this for a postmortem if the final rollout regresses traffic.
